list.title: Active profile
list.description: Applies a preset of options at once. Switch to Custom to stop a profile overwriting your manual toggles.

toggle_switch.title: Apply profile on every boot
toggle_switch.description: Re-applies the active profile at payload load. Leave off if you tune options by hand between boots.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-save config on exit
toggle_switch.description: Writes the current settings to /data/hen/config.ini when you leave this menu.

button.title: [ SAVE CONFIG NOW ]
button.description: Writes current settings to /data/hen/config.ini immediately.

button.title: [ EXPORT CONFIG TO USB ]
button.description: Copies config.ini to the root of the first connected USB drive.

button.title: [ IMPORT CONFIG FROM USB ]
button.description: Loads config.ini from USB and overwrites current settings.
button.confirm: Import config from USB? All current settings will be replaced.

button.title: [ RESET ALL TO DEFAULTS ]
button.description: Returns every option in this menu to its shipped default.
button.confirm: Reset every ModzHEN setting to defaults? This cannot be undone.

list.title: Patch set
list.description: How much of the kernel patch set the payload applies. Full enables everything; Custom honours individual toggles.

toggle_switch.title: Enable exploit fixes
toggle_switch.description: Re-applies patches missed during the initial jailbreak. Improves system stability post-exploit.

toggle_switch.title: Memory mapping patches
toggle_switch.description: Patches needed to decrypt and execute encrypted binaries and system libraries.

toggle_switch.title: Allow unsigned ELF / fSELF
toggle_switch.description: Accepts fake-signed executables. Required to run self-compiled homebrew and ported ELFs.

toggle_switch.title: Disable userland ASLR
toggle_switch.description: Disables Address Space Layout Randomization. Static offsets stay valid across reboots.

toggle_switch.title: Report kernel base to log
toggle_switch.description: Prints the resolved kernel base and ShellCore base to the kernel log at boot.

toggle_switch.title: Disable kernel write protection
toggle_switch.description: Clears CR0.WP so patches can be written to read-only kernel pages.

toggle_switch.title: Unrestrict syscalls
toggle_switch.description: Removes the userland syscall whitelist. Homebrew can call kernel syscalls directly.

toggle_switch.title: Mount system partitions read/write
toggle_switch.description: Remounts /system and /system_ex as writable. A bad write here can prevent booting.
toggle_switch.confirm: Mount system partitions read/write? A bad write to /system can brick the console.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock Sony debug settings
toggle_switch.description: Exposes the hidden system Debug Settings entry in the main Settings list.

toggle_switch.title: Block firmware updates
toggle_switch.description: Unmounts the /update partition to prevent accidental OFW updates.
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable update blocking? The console may download and install a firmware update.

toggle_switch.title: NoBD patches
toggle_switch.description: Allows system functions to operate without a working Blu-ray drive.

toggle_switch.title: Skip userland patches
toggle_switch.description: Skips SceShellCore, SceShellUI, and RemotePlay patches. For testkit users only.
toggle_switch.confirm: Skip userland patches? Homebrew apps will not launch.

toggle_switch.title: Re-patch ShellCore on respawn
toggle_switch.description: Watches for SceShellCore restarting and re-applies patches automatically.

toggle_switch.title: Enable UART debug output
toggle_switch.description: Routes kernel debug output to the UART serial port.

toggle_switch.title: Verbose boot log
toggle_switch.description: Displays detailed initialization output on screen during boot.

toggle_switch.title: Show patch result summary
toggle_switch.description: Prints an applied/failed count per patch group once initialization finishes.

list.title: Target ID spoofer
list.description: Overrides the console's reported Target ID.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-run payload on boot
toggle_switch.description: Loads the HEN payload automatically once the exploit host is reached.

text_input.title: Exploit host URL
text_input.description: Page the browser opens to re-run the exploit after a cold boot.

toggle_switch.title: Open host page on boot
toggle_switch.description: Launches the browser at the URL above when the console reaches the home screen.

text_input.title: Payload retry attempts
text_input.description: How many times to retry a failed exploit attempt. Range: 1-32.

list.title: After jailbreak, go to
list.description: Where the console lands once the payload finishes.

text_input.title: Autostart delay (ms)
text_input.description: Wait before launching autostart target. 3000 is a safe floor.

toggle_switch.title: Survive rest mode
toggle_switch.description: Keeps patches and services alive across suspend/resume.

toggle_switch.title: Skip Sony boot animation
toggle_switch.description: Skips the PlayStation boot logo. Reduces time from power-on to home screen.

list.title: Persistence mode
list.description: How the jailbreak survives across boots. Web host re-runs the exploit from your PC each boot. Persistent writes the exploit chain to internal storage so no PC is needed.

toggle_switch.title: Auto-exploit on cold boot
toggle_switch.description: Triggers the kernel exploit automatically without opening the browser manually. Requires persistent mode.

toggle_switch.title: Cache kernel patches
toggle_switch.description: Saves applied kernel patches to /data/hen/kcache.bin so they can be re-applied faster on next boot.

toggle_switch.title: Verify patches on every boot
toggle_switch.description: Re-reads every patched kernel address after apply to confirm the write stuck. Catches silent failures.

toggle_switch.title: Stealth jailbreak mode
toggle_switch.description: Hides all visible signs of jailbreak from the system UI and PSN. HEN icon removed, debug settings hidden, version strings masked.

toggle_switch.title: Anti-detection engine
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs system integrity checks, hides modified kernel pages, and masks syscall hooks from detection routines.

toggle_switch.title: Anti-ban protection
toggle_switch.description: Blocks telemetry, spoofs console ID hashes, and prevents Sony from fingerprinting the jailbreak. Not guaranteed.

toggle_switch.title: Console ID spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Generates a randomized Console ID (CID) on every boot. Adds a layer of anti-ban protection.

text_input.title: Custom Console ID
text_input.description: 32-hex-digit CID to use instead of random. Leave blank for random generation.

toggle_switch.title: IDPS spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs the console's IDPS (unique hardware identifier) to prevent hardware bans.

text_input.title: Custom IDPS
text_input.description: 32-hex-digit IDPS override. Leave blank for randomized.

toggle_switch.title: PSID spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs the PlayStation ID sent during PSN authentication.

toggle_switch.title: MAC address spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Randomizes the network MAC address on every boot for network-level anonymity.

text_input.title: Custom MAC address
text_input.description: 6-byte hex MAC (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). Leave blank for random.

toggle_switch.title: Full sandbox escape
toggle_switch.description: Escapes all FreeBSD jail restrictions and sets root credentials on the exploit process.

toggle_switch.title: Root filesystem access
toggle_switch.description: Grants full read/write access to the entire filesystem including /system, /preinst, and /update.
toggle_switch.confirm: Enable root filesystem access? A bad write can permanently brick the console.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel module loader
toggle_switch.description: Allows loading custom kernel modules (.ko) from /data/hen/kmod/ at boot. Full ring-0 access.

toggle_switch.title: Syscall hook engine
toggle_switch.description: Intercepts and redirects system calls. Required for advanced features like process hiding and file redirection.

toggle_switch.title: Hide jailbreak processes
toggle_switch.description: Removes HEN-related processes from the process list visible to games and system apps.

toggle_switch.title: File redirection engine
toggle_switch.description: Redirects file I/O operations system-wide. Allows replacing game files without modifying the original.

toggle_switch.title: Disable memory protection
toggle_switch.description: Removes all page protection checks. Any process can read/write any memory region. Required for live patching.

toggle_switch.title: Direct kernel memory map
toggle_switch.description: Maps the kernel's physical memory into userland address space for direct access without syscalls.

toggle_switch.title: Interrupt handler hooks
toggle_switch.description: Hooks hardware interrupt handlers for custom exception handling and debug traps.

toggle_switch.title: Elevated thread priority
toggle_switch.description: Runs PhantomHEN services at kernel-level thread priority for guaranteed execution time.

toggle_switch.title: PhantomHEN watchdog daemon
toggle_switch.description: Monitors all PhantomHEN services and auto-restarts any that crash. Keeps the jailbreak alive.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel crash guard
toggle_switch.description: Catches kernel panics and attempts recovery instead of a full reboot. Experimental.

toggle_switch.title: Custom boot logo
toggle_switch.description: Replaces the Sony boot animation with PhantomHEN branding during exploit initialization.

list.title: Exploit chain
list.description: Which kernel exploit to use. Default is kevent UAF for 14.02.

list.title: Privilege level
list.description: How much kernel access the jailbreak grants.

toggle_switch.title: Persist custom settings on boot
toggle_switch.description: Overwrites payload defaults with your custom PhantomHEN settings XML every boot. This is what keeps your settings permanent.

text_input.title: Settings overwrite delay (ms)
text_input.description: How long to wait after payload init before writing custom settings. Increase if settings reset to defaults.

toggle_switch.title: PS Plus subscription bypass
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs an active PS Plus Essential subscription. Enables online multiplayer, monthly games, and cloud saves without a paid subscription.

list.title: PS Plus tier to spoof
list.description: Which PS Plus tier to emulate.

toggle_switch.title: Online multiplayer bypass
toggle_switch.description: Bypasses the PS Plus check for online multiplayer in all titles. Works independently of the subscription spoof above.

toggle_switch.title: PS Plus game lock bypass
toggle_switch.description: Removes the PS Plus subscription check from downloaded PS Plus monthly games so they remain playable after your subscription expires.

toggle_switch.title: Cloud save bypass
toggle_switch.description: Enables cloud save uploads and downloads without an active PS Plus subscription.

toggle_switch.title: PSN sign-in bypass
toggle_switch.description: Bypasses the PSN sign-in requirement system-wide. Apps and games that require PSN authentication will skip the check.

toggle_switch.title: Offline PSN authentication
toggle_switch.description: Generates valid PSN authentication tokens locally without contacting Sony servers. Allows 'signed in' state while fully offline.

toggle_switch.title: Instant account switch
toggle_switch.description: Allows switching between PSN accounts without signing out or restarting. Useful for multi-user setups.

toggle_switch.title: Age restriction bypass
toggle_switch.description: Removes age-based content restrictions and parental controls from the account.

toggle_switch.title: PSN region bypass
toggle_switch.description: Accesses PSN store content from any region regardless of account region. Browse and download from JP, US, EU stores.

toggle_switch.title: Payment verification bypass
toggle_switch.description: Skips payment method verification for free content downloads that incorrectly require a payment method on file.

toggle_switch.title: 2FA bypass for local ops
toggle_switch.description: Skips two-factor authentication prompts for local operations (settings changes, store browsing). Sign-in still requires 2FA.

toggle_switch.title: Fake Primary PS4
toggle_switch.description: Spoofs primary console activation. Fixes NP-32045-5 errors on PKG-installed games.

toggle_switch.title: License verification bypass
toggle_switch.description: Skips the license check for installed content. Prevents 'Cannot use this content' errors on all installed PKGs.

toggle_switch.title: Trial timer bypass
toggle_switch.description: Removes the time limit from game trials and demos so they run indefinitely.

toggle_switch.title: Share Play bypass
toggle_switch.description: Enables Share Play without PS Plus and removes the 60-minute session limit.

toggle_switch.title: Start services on boot
toggle_switch.description: Brings up every service enabled below as soon as the payload loads.

toggle_switch.title: Service auto-restart watchdog
toggle_switch.description: Restarts a service that dies instead of leaving the port dead.

toggle_switch.title: FTP Server
toggle_switch.description: Starts an FTP server for file transfer.

text_input.title: FTP password
text_input.description: Only used when a username is set above.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel Log Server
toggle_switch.description: Streams kernel log output over the network.

toggle_switch.title: RPC Server
toggle_switch.description: Remote procedure call server for PC-side tools. Required for trainers and memory editors.

toggle_switch.title: Payload / BIN loader
toggle_switch.description: Listens for .bin payloads sent from a PC.

toggle_switch.title: Web file browser
toggle_switch.description: Browser-based file manager for the console's filesystem.

toggle_switch.title: Mount network share (SMB)
toggle_switch.description: Mounts a PC share so games and homebrew can read files off it.

toggle_switch.title: Block Sony telemetry
toggle_switch.description: Blocks outbound telemetry, analytics, and crash reporting to Sony.

toggle_switch.title: Block PSN auto-login
toggle_switch.description: Prevents automatic PSN connection on boot.

toggle_switch.title: Block update domains
toggle_switch.description: Drops DNS lookups for Sony's firmware update hosts.

toggle_switch.title: Remote Play without PSN
toggle_switch.description: Bypasses PSN sign-in requirement for Remote Play over LAN.

toggle_switch.title: Global DNS override
toggle_switch.description: Redirects all system DNS queries to a custom server.

button.title: Network Status
button.description: Shows current IP, gateway, MTU, link speed, and listening service ports. (Requires PhantomHEN network module)

toggle_switch.title: Firmware version spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Reports a spoofed firmware version to games and apps.

toggle_switch.title: Game version spoofer
toggle_switch.description: Reports a spoofed application version for server checks.

toggle_switch.title: Region-free disc playback
toggle_switch.description: Disables disc and game region checks.

toggle_switch.title: Trophy override
toggle_switch.description: Forces all trophy unlocks locally and blocks PSN sync.

toggle_switch.title: Save data unlocker
toggle_switch.description: Removes save encryption and account binding for FTP access.

toggle_switch.title: Force screenshot/video capture
toggle_switch.description: Enables Share button in titles that block it.

toggle_switch.title: Debug settings unlock
toggle_switch.description: Unlocks hidden in-game debug menus (god mode, noclip, spawners).

toggle_switch.title: Force game offline mode
toggle_switch.description: Prevents games from connecting to online services.

toggle_switch.title: Disable auto game patches
toggle_switch.description: Prevents downloading and applying game updates.

toggle_switch.title: Game patch loader
toggle_switch.description: Applies per-title memory patches from XML files at launch.

toggle_switch.title: Force Neo (Pro) mode
toggle_switch.description: Reports the console as PS4 Pro. Base hardware will run slower.

toggle_switch.title: Enable disc image mount
toggle_switch.description: Mount PS4 disc images (.iso/.pkg) from the hard drive.

button.title: Per-Title Settings
button.description: Override options for specific title IDs. (Requires per-title module)

toggle_switch.title: Enable cheat engine
toggle_switch.description: Activates the in-memory cheat engine for trainer plugins and real-time memory patching.

toggle_switch.title: Unrestrict ptrace
toggle_switch.description: Any process can attach to and read/write any other process memory.

toggle_switch.title: Kernel R/W userland API
toggle_switch.description: Exposes kernel memory read/write to userland processes.

toggle_switch.title: Memory scanner service
toggle_switch.description: Scan server for PC-side value scanning and narrowing.

button.title: Cheat Manager
button.description: Browse loaded tables, toggle cheats, bind hotkeys. (Requires cheat module)

toggle_switch.title: Enable save resigning
toggle_switch.description: Resigns save data to match current console's account ID.

text_input.title: Target account ID
text_input.description: 16-hex-digit account ID. Blank uses current user.

button.title: [ BACKUP ALL SAVES TO USB ]
button.description: Copies all saves to /PS4/SAVEDATA/ on USB storage.

button.title: [ RESTORE SAVES FROM USB ]
button.description: Restore saves from /PS4/SAVEDATA/ on USB. Resigning applied automatically.
button.confirm: Restore saves from USB? Existing saves will be overwritten.

button.title: [ BROWSE SAVE DATA ]
button.description: Lists every save on the console with title ID, size, and owner account.

toggle_switch.title: CPU / GPU boost mode
toggle_switch.description: Raises CPU to 2.13 GHz and GPU to 911 MHz. Ensure adequate cooling.
toggle_switch.confirm: Enable boost mode? Ensure the console has adequate cooling.

toggle_switch.title: Disable thermal throttling
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable thermal throttling? Can cause hardware damage without proper cooling.

toggle_switch.title: Unlock reserved CPU cores
toggle_switch.description: Releases system-reserved cores for homebrew use.
toggle_switch.confirm: Unlock reserved cores? System shell may become unstable.

toggle_switch.title: Coredump on crash
toggle_switch.description: Writes full process coredump to /data/hen/coredumps/ on crash.

toggle_switch.title: Syscall tracer
toggle_switch.description: Very noisy — enable for one title at a time.

text_input.title: RPC auth token
text_input.description: Shared secret for RPC. Blank = no auth.

button.title: [ DUMP KERNEL ]
button.description: Dumps the running kernel to /data/hen/dumps/. Use to derive offsets.

button.title: [ DUMP PROCESS ]
button.description: Dumps a process's main module and memory map.

button.title: [ DECRYPT SELF / ELF ]
button.description: Decrypts a signed executable to plain ELF for analysis.

toggle_switch.title: Enable plugin system
toggle_switch.description: Loads PRX plugins from /data/hen/plugins/ at game launch.
toggle_switch.confirm: Disable the plugin system? FTP, kernel log, and settings menu will stop working.

toggle_switch.title: Write default plugin files to HDD
toggle_switch.description: Copies built-in plugin PRX files to /data/hen/plugins/. Run once on first setup.

text_input.title: Plugin load delay (ms)
text_input.description: Wait after process start before injecting. Raise if plugins crash on launch.

toggle_switch.title: Plugin crash recovery
toggle_switch.description: Game continues loading if a plugin crashes during injection.

text_input.title: Blocked title IDs
text_input.description: Comma-separated title IDs that never receive plugin injection.

button.title: Plugin Load Order
button.description: Reorder plugin injection priority. (Requires plugin order module)

button.title: Per-Title Plugin Rules
button.description: Choose which plugins load for which title ID. (Requires rules module)

link.title: Install from Hard Disk
link.description: Installs PKG files from the path above.

link.title: Install from USB Storage
link.description: Installs PKG files from a connected USB drive.

button.title: Install from Network
button.description: Install a package from HTTP. Enter the URL below first.

text_input.title: Allowed client IP
text_input.description: Only this IP may connect to debug services. Blank = any LAN address.

toggle_switch.title: Require auth token on all services

text_input.title: Homebrew menu PIN
text_input.description: 4-button PIN (e.g. XOXO = Cross Circle Cross Circle).

toggle_switch.title: Lock settings after boot
toggle_switch.description: Makes this menu read-only once payload has applied.

toggle_switch.title: Disable power button hold-off
toggle_switch.description: Requires double-press to shutdown.

list.title: System font
list.description: Changes the system-wide font face. Applied to all menus, notifications, and overlays in real-time.

text_input.title: Custom font path
text_input.description: Path to a .ttf or .otf font file on USB or HDD.

list.title: Font weight
list.description: Controls the thickness of rendered text.

toggle_switch.title: Font anti-aliasing
toggle_switch.description: Smooths font edges. Disable for a sharper pixel look.

toggle_switch.title: Text drop shadow
toggle_switch.description: Adds a subtle shadow behind text for readability on busy backgrounds.

toggle_switch.title: Text outline
toggle_switch.description: Draws a thin outline around all text characters.

toggle_switch.title: Apply font to system menus
toggle_switch.description: Extends the font change to the PS4 system menus beyond ModzHEN.

text_input.title: Primary text color (hex)
text_input.description: Main text color for menus and UI. Format: RRGGBB (e.g. FFFFFF for white).

text_input.title: Accent / highlight color (hex)
text_input.description: Selected items, active toggles, and progress bars. Format: RRGGBB.

text_input.title: Header / title color (hex)
text_input.description: Section headers and category titles. Format: RRGGBB.

text_input.title: Warning text color (hex)
text_input.description: Used for dangerous options and confirmation dialogs. Format: RRGGBB.

text_input.title: Success text color (hex)
text_input.description: Used for completed operations and active status indicators. Format: RRGGBB.

list.title: Color preset
list.description: Quick-apply a color scheme. Overrides individual colors above.

toggle_switch.title: Live color preview
toggle_switch.description: Applies color changes immediately as you type instead of waiting for menu exit.

toggle_switch.title: Apply colors to system UI
toggle_switch.description: Extends the color override to the PS4 system menus beyond PhantomHEN.

toggle_switch.title: Enable display name override
toggle_switch.description: Replaces your PSN Online ID with a custom name in the system UI, notifications, and supported games.

text_input.title: Custom display name
text_input.description: The name shown on the home screen, in-game, and in party chat.

toggle_switch.title: Apply name in games
toggle_switch.description: Overrides the display name inside games that read it from the system. Not all games support this.

toggle_switch.title: Apply name in party chat
toggle_switch.description: Shows your custom name to other party members instead of your PSN ID.

toggle_switch.title: Add random suffix
toggle_switch.description: Appends a random 4-digit number to the display name for uniqueness (e.g. PhantomHEN_User#1337).

text_input.title: Console name
text_input.description: Custom name for this PS4 on the network (visible in Remote Play, media servers, etc.).

toggle_switch.title: Colored name (overlay only)
toggle_switch.description: Renders your display name in the accent color in the PhantomHEN overlay.

toggle_switch.title: Matrix rain background
toggle_switch.description: Animated green character rain behind the overlay panel.

text_input.title: Overlay watermark text
text_input.description: Short string in the overlay corner. Blank disables.

toggle_switch.title: Custom boot splash
toggle_switch.description: Place a 1920x1080 PNG at /data/hen/splash.png.

toggle_switch.title: Hide PhantomHEN icon on home screen
Custom notification sounds
toggle_switch.description: From /data/hen/sounds/.

text_input.title: Internal: Free Space
text_input.description: Available space on the internal drive.

text_input.title: External: Free Space
text_input.description: Available space on extended storage (if connected).

text_input.title: Patches Applied
text_input.description: Count of successfully applied kernel patches.

text_input.title: Plugins Loaded
text_input.description: Count of successfully loaded PRX plugins.

button.title: [ EXPORT INFO TO USB ]
button.description: Writes a text report of system info to USB.

toggle_switch.title: Safe mode on next boot
toggle_switch.description: Next boot applies minimum patch set and starts no services.

toggle_switch.title: Self-test on boot
toggle_switch.description: Verifies each patch and service port, reports failures.

toggle_switch.title: Auto safe mode after crash loop
toggle_switch.description: Two crashes in a row triggers safe mode on next boot.

text_input.title: Faulting Process
text_input.description: Name of the process that crashed.

text_input.title: Last Apply Result
text_input.description: Overall status of the most recent patch application.

button.title: [ PANIC RESTORE ]
button.description: Reverts every setting to minimal safe configuration and restarts the shell.
button.confirm: Panic restore? All settings revert to minimal safe configuration.

button.title: [ CLEAR LOGS & DUMPS ]
button.description: Deletes /data/hen/logs/, /data/hen/dumps/, and /data/hen/coredumps/.
button.confirm: Delete all logs, dumps, and coredumps?

link.title: ★ Jailbreak Mods
link.description: Permanent kernel-level mod options. Debug, dev flags, fan control, region-free, trophy sync, and more.

link.title: ★ UI Tweaks
link.description: Font changer, text color changer, name changer, and shell overlay options.

link.title: ★ PSN Bypass
link.description: PS Plus bypasser, sign-in bypasser, ban prevention, and telemetry kill switches.

button.title: Restart ShellUI
button.description: Restarts the system shell. Apply after changing payload options or plugin settings.

button.title: Reload Payload
button.description: Re-runs the payload with current settings without a full reboot.
button.confirm: Reload the payload now? Any running game will be closed.

button.title: Restart Services
button.description: Stops and restarts FTP, RPC, klog, and the payload loader.

button.title: Reboot Console
button.description: Full restart. Required for clock, ASLR, and boot-stage patch changes.
